issues.on_page: Insurance Fund Miscellaneous 1,628,375; p2 Insurance Reimbursements 1,411,338
issues.issue: The receipts and detail lists categorize this money differently. In receipts, only 1,411,338 of Miscellaneous counts as reimbursements and the other 527,507 is other. In detail, the whole Insurance Fund Miscellaneous 1,628,375 is reimbursements, which is 217,037 more than the government-wide reimbursements figure.
The final budget for the whole Taxes line is attached to the 132,995 other-taxes split item only, so budget-vs-actual for that item is meaningless. A review note is present.
